gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-cascadia-code: Literary weight meets wire-thin lines. Lisu Bosa does its best work with gentle stroke contrast and wide round openings, while Cascadia Code holds every letter apart on a smooth monoline skeleton.
gen-gf-mate-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish curves, then a sharper edge. Bespoke Sans keeps generous room where its curves meet the stems, so a full page of it reads crisp and refined, while Mate adds a subtle gradient of weight overhead.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-karma: Metamorphous spaces its letters with large sidebearings and a high-set midline, giving each headline a commanding, distinctive stance. Karma's serif text glides along, its calm modulation never snagging the eye.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-ranade: Commanding display letters, then a loose drift. Metamorphous does its best with large sidebearings and a high midline, while Ranade spreads widely spaced, softly shifting strokes across the line.
gen-gf-noto-sans-chakma-fs-erode: The text serif underneath reads dignified, its weight gently ebbing, while Noto Sans Chakma above stays clean with tapered strokes. Erode's broad apertures and tall middle band keep paragraph after paragraph moving.
gen-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western-fs-karma: Karma reads like a trusted, classic text serif. Noto Sans Syriac Western stands tall with short stems and open curve tips, while Karma keeps its thick-thin variation low-key and gentle.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-fs-asap: Bookish and sturdy, Noto Serif Grantha sets a big x-height beside stubby ascenders and gently modulated strokes. Asap's open arcs keep it readable against that sturdy, bookish weight.
gen-gf-nova-mono-fs-ranade: Nova Mono keeps its curves matching its stems in thickness, with short ascenders over big bowls and zero modulation. Ranade loosens that, with slightly shifting weight and widely spaced strokes.
gen-gf-nova-mono-work-sans: Nova Mono looks precise and technical up top. Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and its mean line high, so paragraphs move along with an unhurried, contemporary ease.
gen-gf-nova-round-fs-rowan: Nova Round is a bold ribbon of constant width. It does its best work in display moments, not long paragraphs, while Rowan's lightly flexed, generous curves carry the reading.
